description: Orbolo connects investors, ranches, and buyers across Paraguay — own cattle on a working ranch, or source grass-fed beef raised under the Orbolo Code.
Own cattle on a working ranch in Paraguay, raised under the Orbolo Code. A ranch releases for deployment once 60% of its threshold is committed.
Grass-fed beef from Paraguay, sold at conventional prices. We’re building a 300,000-head producer alliance and a full traceability layer behind it.
El Tapir is Orbolo’s own farm in Paraguay’s Gran Chaco. See how Ganadería a Pasto grows supply, and find out how to work with us if you own land.
Reach Orbolo about investing in a herd, buying grass-fed Paraguayan beef, or putting your land to work in a managed grazing partnership.
